references.text: Jokneam is mentioned as one of the Canaanite kings whom Joshua defeated, confirming the site's significance in the boundary description.
Jokneam is listed as part of Manasseh's inheritance, illustrating the overlapping border areas between Zebulun and Manasseh.
Jokneam was given to the Levites from the tribe of Zebulun, confirming the site's location within Zebulun's territory.
Jokneam is mentioned in connection with Solomon's administrative districts, highlighting the site's continued importance.
